# Anivora 0.1.39 — Community and support

- Add Community & support in Profile with the official Discord destination, support-command guidance, and a structured bug-report form.
- Open a Cloudflare-hosted report form from the app without joining Discord or using Render bandwidth. Require Turnstile verification, validate public report fields, make device details optional, and retain a stable reference for retries. The report page explains public visibility and privacy.
- Extend the existing Cloudflare Discord bridge with signed HTTP interactions, structured public bug/feature reports, private support tickets, staff status handling, native AutoMod setup, verified release announcements and measured account-service notifications.
- Preserve current authentication, playback, downloads/HLS, manga, libraries, history, comments, notifications, Cast/TV pairing and public GitHub updates. No Discord membership or account linking is required to use Anivora.

Android version code **41**, newer than 0.1.38/code 40. Package
`com.brandon300.anivora`; ARM64; Android 7.0/API 24 or newer. The established signing
certificate and APK verification gates are retained. Install over the existing app.

## Availability and limits

The existing Render account backend is billing-suspended until its bandwidth allowance resets. Community support, public reporting, release automation and D1 admin metrics run on Cloudflare independently. Account sync and other account-dependent features still require Render. Private GitHub issue integration needs a dedicated Issues token;
interactive Codex authorization is not a deployed credential. Discord OAuth linking,
Gateway member-join automation and unattended two-way private issue synchronization
are not enabled. Commands use scheduled work where necessary, so deferred actions
may take a minute or longer under load. Existing bug-channel history is retained
using per-report threads rather than converting the channel to a forum.

Validation includes app TypeScript/lint/tests, backend and bridge tests, Expo checks,
Android native/regression tests, compiled-source verification, and APK identity,
signer and download checks. Only checks that actually pass will be recorded in the
release evidence. Physical Hot 50i and Chromecast testing remain pending.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/2d487259ad7c44bb277200022a2b8e7b85dbebe5
